mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name AS company, c.industry, contact.full_name AS contact_name, contact.email AS contact_email, contact.phone AS contact_phone, contact.job_title AS contact_title, c.source, COALESCE(c.attributes ->> 'leadStatus', CASE WHEN c.stage = 'QUALIFIED' THEN 'QUALIFIED' WHEN c.stage = 'LOST' THEN 'DISQUALIFIED' ELSE 'NEW' END) AS status, c.owner_member_id, owner.display_name AS owner_name, NULLIF(c.attributes ->> 'score', '')::integer AS score, c.attributes ->> 'nextAction' AS next_action, c.next_follow_up_at, c.last_interaction_at AS last_activity_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM customer c LEFT JOIN customer_contact contact ON contact.organization_id = c.organization_id AND contact.customer_id = c.id AND contact.is_primary = true AND contact.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN organization_member member ON member.organization_id = c.organization_id AND member.id = c.owner_member_id LEFT JOIN app_user owner ON owner.id = member.user_id
mapper.select:
WHERE c.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND (c.stage = 'LEAD' OR c.attributes ->> 'leadOrigin' = 'true')
AND COALESCE(c.attributes ->> 'leadStatus', 'NEW') = #{status}
AND (c.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR contact.full_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR contact.email ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR contact.phone ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%'))
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(attributes ->> 'leadStatus', 'NEW') IN ('NEW', 'CONTACTED', 'NURTURING')) AS pending, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attributes ->> 'leadStatus' = 'QUALIFIED') AS qualified, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE owner_member_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(attributes ->> 'leadStatus', 'NEW') NOT IN ('QUALIFIED', 'DISQUALIFIED')) AS unassigned, COALESCE(AVG(NULLIF(attributes ->> 'score', '')::numeric), 0)::double precision AS average_score FROM customer WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (stage = 'LEAD' OR attributes ->> 'leadOrigin' = 'true')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_member WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT member.id, app_user.display_name AS name FROM organization_member member JOIN app_user ON app_user.id = member.user_id WHERE member.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND member.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY app_user.display_name, member.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer (id, organization_id, owner_member_id, name, industry, stage, status, source, next_follow_up_at, attributes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{company}, #{industry}, 'LEAD', 'ACTIVE', #{source}, #{nextFollowUpAt}, jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('leadOrigin', true, 'leadStatus', #{status}, 'score', #{score}, 'nextAction', #{nextAction})), #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO customer_contact (id, organization_id, customer_id, full_name, email, phone, job_title, is_primary, source, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{leadId}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{title}, true, #{source}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET name = #{company}, industry = #{industry}, source = #{source}, owner_member_id = #{ownerMemberId}, next_follow_up_at = #{nextFollowUpAt}, attributes = jsonb_strip_nulls(attributes || jsonb_build_object('leadOrigin', true, 'leadStatus', #{status}, 'score', #{score}, 'nextAction', #{nextAction})), updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{leadId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(attributes ->> 'leadStatus', 'NEW') NOT IN ('QUALIFIED', 'DISQUALIFIED')

UPDATE customer_contact SET full_name = #{name}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, job_title = #{title}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND customer_id = #{leadId} AND is_primary = true AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE customer SET owner_member_id = #{ownerMemberId}, attributes = jsonb_set(attributes, '{leadStatus}', to_jsonb((CASE WHEN COALESCE(attributes ->> 'leadStatus', 'NEW') = 'NEW' THEN 'NURTURING' ELSE attributes ->> 'leadStatus' END)::text)), updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{leadId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(attributes ->> 'leadStatus', 'NEW') NOT IN ('QUALIFIED', 'DISQUALIFIED')

UPDATE customer SET stage = 'QUALIFIED', attributes = jsonb_set(attributes || jsonb_build_object('leadOrigin', true), '{leadStatus}', '"QUALIFIED"'::jsonb), updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{leadId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(attributes ->> 'leadStatus', 'NEW') NOT IN ('QUALIFIED', 'DISQUALIFIED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opportunity (id, organization_id, customer_id, owner_member_id, name, stage, status, amount, currency, probability, expected_close_date, source, attributes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{customerId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{name}, 'QUALIFIED', 'OPEN', #{amount}, 'CNY', 20, #{expectedCloseDate}, 'MANUAL', '{"forecastCategory":"PIPELINE"}'::jsonb, #{now}, #{now})
